title: MAAP Morning CBD Loop & Espresso
description: Kick off TDU week with a spirited 48 km social spin through the Adelaide parklands and river trail, wrapping up at the MAAP Pop-up for complimentary espresso and pastries.

title: Rapha Norton Summit & Lofty Coffee Ride
description: The quintessential Adelaide climbing route. Roll out from Tour Village up Norton Summit to Mount Lofty Summit cafe before dropping back into town ahead of Stage 3.

title: Sunset Coastal Cruise to Glenelg
description: An easy-paced twilight recovery ride along the coastal bike path from Glenelg to Brighton and back. Cold drinks and sunset vibes at the beachside pavilion.

title: City of Adelaide Tour Village Opening Night
description: Live DJ sets, South Australian food stalls, craft beer garden, team mechanic stages, and rider Q&A panels in the heart of Adelaide.

title: Adelaide Hills Post-Stage Winery Social
description: Celebrate Stage 3 in the Hills! Relax under the gum trees with local Adelaide Hills cool-climate wines, wood-fired pizza, and live acoustic music.

title: Bridge Road Brewers Craft Beer Pop-up
description: Special batch TDU pale ales on tap, cycling film screenings, custom merchandise giveaways, and local food trucks right in the CBD.

title: Rapha Clubhouse & Espresso Pop-up
description: Limited-edition TDU 2027 capsule collection, live race streaming on big screens, artisanal specialty coffee, and pre-ride bike checkups.

title: Santos Family Tour & Strider Balance Bike Zone
description: A fun-filled family day featuring free obstacle courses for kids on closed city streets, balance bike races, face painting, and giveaways from cycling stars.

title: Glenelg Beachfront Kids Crit & Carnival
description: Bring the whole family down to the beach! Supervised junior circuit laps, seaside ice cream stalls, sandcastle competitions, and front-row stage watching.
